task_completion.description: Agent opens and analyzes inventory_velocity.csv to identify product velocities.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A spreadsheet viewer, text editor, or terminal output showing the contents of inventory_velocity.csv.

task_completion.description: Agent opens the warehouse_current.drawio file in a diagramming tool.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The draw.io (diagrams.net) interface or a similar GUI showing the initial warehouse layout.

task_completion.description: The Top 4 Fast Mover racks are moved to Zone A (East side near Packing/Shipping).
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing 'Phone Accessories', 'Consumer Electronics', 'Vitamins & Supplements', and 'Pet Food' racks positioned on the right/East side of the diagram.

task_completion.description: The Bottom 4 Slow Mover racks are moved to Zone C (West side/rear).
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the four lowest velocity racks (e.g., Kayak Accessories) positioned on the left/West side of the diagram.

task_completion.description: Zone A is labeled and a Pick Path arrow is drawn from the Office to the Packing Area.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text label or highlighted area marked 'Zone A' and a visible arrow line connecting the Office area to the Packing Area through the aisles.

task_completion.description: The final diagram is exported as a PDF to the specified directory.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Export as PDF' dialog box or a file manager showing optimized_layout.pdf in ~/Diagrams/exports/.

integrity.description: Agent used the diagramming GUI to move elements rather than just script manipulation.
integrity.visual_evidence: Mouse cursor movements, drag-and-drop actions, or selection boxes visible over the rack elements in the draw.io interface.

integrity.description: Agent did not simply use a command-line tool to generate a PDF without editing the layout.
integrity.visual_evidence: Visual confirmation of the agent manually moving rack objects and drawing the arrow line in the GUI.

integrity.description: Agent actually opened the CSV to find the categories rather than guessing.
integrity.visual_evidence: The inventory_velocity.csv file being displayed on screen prior to the layout changes.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The Top 4 Fast Movers (to be moved to the East/Zone A) are: 1. Phone Accessories, 2. Consumer Electronics, 3. Vitamins & Supplements, 4. Pet Food. The Packing Area is located on the East side. Zone C is the West side. The Pick Path must be a continuous arrow starting at the Office and ending at the Packing Area. The final file must be named optimized_layout.pdf.
